run_f_gold: run f_gold to compute the maximum area rectangle from an array of side lengths
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple parameter sets to verify correct maximum rectangle area calculation
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which finds two largest equal pairs in a sorted array to compute max rectangle area
review_f_gold: review f_gold algorithm that sorts descending and picks two largest duplicate pairs for rectangle dimensions
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to avoid mutating the input array by using a sorted copy instead of in-place sort
